description: Zero-dependency TypeScript library that renders terminal charts as strings: braille line, bar, scatter, candlestick via a composable builder, plus inline sparklines, heatmaps, histograms, and gauges.
rules: Pass the builder to renderToAnsi/renderToString/renderToHtml; they call .build() internally
For CI snapshots use renderToString with explicit width, height, and yDomain
ESM only; use import, not require
